common_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: finished 2D game environment prop, individual transparent PNG.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET to redraw; Images 2, 3, 4 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY (the three game UI screens). Do not reproduce their UI, frames, lettering, characters or entire background.
Primary request: Preserve the distinctive mushroom silhouette, anatomy, pose and identifying surreal features of Image 1 while redrawing it as a polished flat illustration that belongs naturally in the game world of the three UI references. One asset only, never a contact sheet.
Style/medium: hand-drawn 2D flat fantasy forest illustration. Clear organic silhouettes; moderate thin dark blue contour with slight hand variation; restrained, deliberate tapered brush strokes; large clean opaque color shapes, 2-3 simple shadow planes and a few broad painted accents. Flatten the rendering, simplify microscopic details and dense gill hatching into a small number of readable curved graphic bands. Smooth clean fills with only extremely subtle brush character, no granular paper texture.
Palette: night-forest blue and desaturated petrol teal for shadows and vegetation, cool pale blue-lavender for stems/undersides, restrained dusty rose and berry pink for caps. Approximate palette navy #142c43, blue #35647d, petrol #28616c, pale blue #bad4df, lavender #a4abc5, dusty rose #bf6189, deeper berry #923e65. Keep colors distinct and clean, moderate saturation, no muddy brown wash. These assets must remain readable over the dark blue-green map reference.
Composition: complete main subject dominates the asset, retain its source proportions and viewing angle; add only a compact organically shaped ground patch with a few simplified teal leaves, moss and 2-3 small stones or small secondary mushrooms when appropriate. Supporting scenery stays subordinate, main subject occupies about 80% of the composition. Generous clear margin, no cropped cap, stem or base.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the mushroom and compact supporting scenery, also transparent in all natural gaps; no white or colored rectangular backdrop, checkerboard drawing, opaque mist, glow, or cast shadow outside the base.
Avoid: excessive noise, stippling, grain, stippled shading, dense scratchy hatch lines, gritty textures, muddy blurred colors, oversaturation, neon, realistic glossy eyeballs, 3D volume, photorealism, complex landscapes, extra creatures or props, text, logo, watermark. Remove source compression and cutout glitches.
Framing requirement: zoom out enough to contain the COMPLETE silhouette with a clearly visible 8-10% TRANSPARENT MARGIN on every side, including above the cap and under the base. Do not use the source's tight crop. This is essential.
